library.description: RPC host with transport and feature plugins.

blocks.text: `contract` 定义协议、接口、可移植值和错误契约；`host` 负责 RPC 调用、会话、握手、provider、转发与取消。传输 plugin 负责原生连接、代际、编解码、分帧与 transfer；信息流 plugin 和依附于 plugin 的 feature 各自实现可选能力。
一个 host 可以安装多个传输，调用按 `host.<ns>` 隔离。不建议一个 host 混用多种传输；通常每个 host 选择一种。
English · 使用指南

blocks.code: pnpm add @migaia/rpc-host @migaia/rpc-contract @migaia/rpc-plugin-coroutines

blocks.text: `@migaia/rpc-contract` 是精确 lockstep 的 peer 依赖，必须与 host 和传输插件一起安装相同版本。它们共用应用提供的同一份 contract；开发者显式安装的重复副本不在支持范围内。

错误类、错误判断和可移植值使用 `@migaia/rpc-host/contract`：它按名字转出 `RpcLifecycleError`、`RpcConstructionError`、`RpcAbortError`、`isRpcError`、`isRpcErrorInstance`、`isRpcRemoteError`、`isRpcTimeoutError`、`RPC_CORE_ERROR_SOURCE`、`normalizeRpcPortable`，以及 `RpcError` 等错误类型和 `IRpcPortableValue`。转出与应用提供的 contract 保持同一个对象，跨入口 `instanceof` 一致。原根入口的 contract 值与类型已迁移到此处，不保留旧转出；`createRpcHost` 仍从根入口导入。
下面建立两个同一事件循环内的真实 host。父端的 timeout feature 安装在 coroutine plugin 上；子端接收本代专属 connect 句柄。输出 `42`，finally 关闭原生资源。
协程不提供 Worker 隔离。独立进程、原生线程和浏览器场景分别选择 process、thread 和 browser 的传输 plugin。
`createRpcHost` 在同一个原生 plugin-host 上先提交信息流 plugin、链路策略 plugin 及其 feature，再安装传输 plugin 及其 feature。传输开始握手时，auth 等 stage 已经可用；后续安装失败由同一生命周期 owner 回滚并释放已取得的资源。

构造后可用 `const extended = await host.use(transport)` 后装传输，返回同一个冻结的原生 host，并在返回值的类型上增加命名空间。每次 `use` 独立提交或回滚；构造时那一批则一起成功或失败。改变消息流的宿主级 Feature 只能在构造的 `plugins` 中配置，后装会以 `INVALID_CONFIG` 拒绝；后装传输自动借用它们，传输自己的 `features` 随传输一起安装，仍只覆盖本命名空间。只读观察插件，包括警告订阅，可以后装。

已有 `defineHost` 或 class 宿主通过 `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk` 的 `rpcHostPipelines(getHost, pipeline)` 取得 `domainCore`，并把原生构造请求转交 `pipeline(name, request)`。每个传输自己声明管道，无需预列命名空间。普通原生宿主用 `rpcFlowPlugin([...features])` 安装共享信息流，再装传输。具体接法见使用指南。

blocks.text: 上述无目标调用只在所属命名空间内选择目标：零个返回空 `fulfilled/rejected`，一个返回标量，多个返回按实例身份索引的 `fulfilled/rejected`。流集合中的迭代器独立取消。根级 `host.request` 等调用入口已删除。
定向流使用 `streamTo`，目标放在第一个参数；`stream` 的 options 不再接受 `targetId`。两者复用相同的流背压、取消和代次隔离。
`remote.host.use`、`remote.host.unUse` 和 `remote.host.inspect` 已移除，不再提供通过 RPC 管理远端宿主插件的协议；本地原生宿主的安装与释放 API 保持各自契约。
`host.<ns>.send('b', 'c.render', value)` 先到直连 b，再由 b 查询当前目录并转发到 c。持有的 `host.<ns>.peers.c.render` 不会自动改指重连后的新代。转发可跨命名空间，且不能延长上游截止时间。
在 `createRpcHost` 上用 `forward: { maxHops: 3 }` 配置各转发 host。默认 3，只接受 1–16 的整数，其他值以 `INVALID_CONFIG` 拒绝。各 host 检查自己的转发跳序；先检查环路，再检查跳数。

同一组 `authFeature`、`chunkFeature`、`batchFeature`、`idempotencyFeature`、`limitsFeature`、`errorMapFeature`、`schemaFeature` 工厂既可放进 host 的 `plugins`，也可放进传输的 `features`。host 配置作用于所有命名空间；传输配置只覆盖本命名空间的同种能力，每个命名空间只启用一份实现。host 级 `limitsFeature` 跨命名空间共用额度，传输级各自独立。`probe`、`typegen` 和 Devtools 只装在 host 级。原 `namespaces` 作用范围选项已删除，按传输选择范围时使用 `features`。

汇总入口与默认子路径导入均可 tree-shake。推荐安装 `limitsFeature`；省略它就不启用这些配额。安装 `idempotencyFeature` 后，才有 `host.<ns>.outcome(key)`。auth 默认把签名绑定对象交给 `sign/verify`；文本和字节模式只编码一层绑定。它的请求 ID 去重默认在完成后立即释放，也可选择签名窗口或毫秒 `retain`；`maxReplayEntriesPerPeer` 只限制数字保留模式，`onRejected` 接收容量拒绝原因。配置和 HMAC 示例见认证说明。
`errorMapFeature` 同步决定对端能看到哪些错误信息，不改变本地原错、report、警告或日志观察。回调抛错、返回 Promise 或结果无法序列化时，报告映射失败，并按未映射时的规则发送原错误。未配置映射时，未认证对端的握手失败仍默认隐藏细节。见错误映射。

自定义信息流通过 `defineFlowFeature` 的 `setup` 返回 `stages`，放进宿主的 `plugins` 或某个传输的 `features`；stage 接收该管道的 payload 和原生 `next(payload)`。观察事件单独放在 `observe`。frame 管道允许多次提交，各成员独立：捕获并报告一个成员失败后可以继续交出下一个；忽略失败的 `next()` Promise 会使管道拒绝。被取消的 batch 成员由原调用以 `CANCELLED` 结算，原 reason 保留在 `cause`，其他成员照常完成。
内置位置固定：出站 plaintext → schema → idempotency → limits → errorMap → auth → chunk → batch → wire；入站反向。数组书写顺序不改变这些位置。第三方 stage 默认在 plaintext，高阶 SDK 作者可显式指定受支持的 `layer`。

`authFeature` 对完整消息执行保护，再由 `chunkFeature` 拆成物理帧；接收端先重组，再还原保护。probe 的 `protected` 事件对应整条消息，`frame` 事件保留实际 `chunkIndex`、`chunkCount` 和 `members`。物理 batch 的成员数在 batch frame 上观察；`envelope` 事件仍对每条逻辑消息观察一次。
自定义载体可以提供可选的 `reserveWrite`，借用已有流控容量。每次逻辑写出只预留一次；chunk 的分片共用凭据，batch 保留各成员的凭据，完成后释放。`write` 的完成仍表示实际物理接纳，`close` 必须结算载体拥有的排队写入。
载体支持原生二进制时，显式列在 `transfer` 中的 ArrayBuffer 始终原生转移，移交后原 buffer 被 detach；配置签名时也会计算并校验摘要。没有显式转移的小 buffer 在签名路径上可内联，原 buffer 保留可用；未配置签名时不计算二进制摘要。共享 buffer 的视图仍保持别名关系和偏移。见二进制说明。
会话使用中的共享或局部信息流 Feature 不能热卸载，移除相应原生注册以 `LIFECYCLE_MUTATION` 拒绝；先关闭受影响命名空间，再冷删除。auth、chunk、batch 等改变线上格式的能力，只有两端都安装才保证能建立通信；单端配置不提供兼容保证，也不主动禁止。见后装与卸载。
pool 是传输的 `pool({ size })` feature，同一池只包含同载体成员，只公开一个逻辑对端。成员打开、调度和关闭属于 pool；`host.<ns>.members` 由传输提供原生控制。

`FeatureScope` 唯一解析覆盖顺序：单次调用 `options.timeout/retry`、所在传输 plugin 的 feature、链路策略 plugin。单次值只接受完整 feature 实例或 `false`，不接受数字或配置对象。`timeout: false` 不启用 feature 超时，持续等待响应；已经继承的上游剩余期限仍递减。`retry: false` 禁用重试。只有发起方的标量调用和 group 重试，stream 从不重放、只使用 timeout；转发跳不重新开始预算。
进入 provider 前剩余截止时间已经耗尽的调用，以 `DEADLINE_EXCEEDED` 拒绝，不执行 provider；`before-start` 的取消语义保持不变。
所有调用种类支持 `signal`，单向调用物理发送之后也能向下游传播取消。provider 读取自己的 `context.signal`。取消不等于杀进程，也不回滚业务副作用。
按 `source/code` 识别错误，保留原生类型、`stack`、`cause` 和 `AggregateError.errors`。超时或断开不证明业务未执行；非幂等操作须先对账再考虑重试。

`send`、`request` 等返回 Promise 的调用通过拒绝传播非法 `idempotencyKey`、transfer 准入被拒绝或命名空间已关闭的错误，保留各入口原有的 `source/code` 和 `cause`；非法 key 仍为 `CONTRACT_INVALID`。使用 `await` 或 `Promise.catch` 处理失败。`dispatch` 仍同步返回 `void` 并向 reporter 交付失败，`stream` 与 `streamTo` 仍返回延迟启动的异步迭代器。
公开 provider 注册失败以 `INVALID_CONFIG` 拒绝，原注册错误直接保留在 `cause`；错误说明不通过调用异常的字符串转换来生成。关闭后，待决调用以 `ENDPOINT_DISPOSED` 结算，实际载体关闭会拒绝仍被挂住的写入；不要求任意业务 Promise 因关闭而强行完成。

自定义 plugin 作者从 `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk` 开始。观察入口是 `/plugins/probe`；旧 `/plugin`、`/probe`、endpoint、per-session Peer 和 v1/JSON-RPC profile 已删除。rpc 家族可以直接依赖 `@migaia/rpc-contract`；只需错误码时导入 `/error-code`，不会带入协议与编解码执行代码。

未分类的 provider 异常使用 `INTERNAL`，原生异常保留在错误图中。标量调用直接以还原的远端 Error 拒绝；不再增加 `RpcRemoteError` 外壳，调用方须改用真实错误的 `source/code`。协程远端 `context.signal.reason` 接收原 abort reason，不合成取消码；`stream.return(value)` 返回 runtime 的真实结束结果，不回传调用者传入的 `value`。
无目标调用按调用时已接受的会话选择；从 `peers` 保存的函数绑定原代次，退场后拒绝且不转向替代连接。即时 process 启动失败只保留一层 `PROCESS_CHANNEL_CLOSED`，原生 EPIPE 在 cause 图中；没有真实原生错误的 thread 关闭诊断不合成 message-port cause。
自行构造的原生宿主保留 `dispose()` 的原生 cleanup summary 与共享 Promise，不再附加 RPC 清理外壳。原失败叶对象、errors 顺序、cause 可达性和 disposer 一次执行保持；`createRpcHost` 返回的 `host.close()` 则保持自己的公开关闭语义。
幂等指纹使用对象自身的键序；同一 body 改变键序后是不同请求，同键冲突以 `CONTRACT_INVALID` 拒绝，原 store 的字符串指纹 ABI 保持不变。
原生 Feature 的 descriptors 每次冷编译只捕获一次，首次 selector 的校验及错误顺序保持；后续 selector 不再重复触发 Proxy reflection。
auth 的默认签名输入从文本改为对象；依赖文本的回调自行规范化，或设置 `encodedType: 'string'`。完成的请求 ID 默认立即释放，需要旧行为时配置 `retain: 310_000`。本地 verifier 与凭据解析器的原始错误保留在 cause 上，对端脱敏通过同步 `errorMapFeature` 控制。
配置 sign/verify 时，auth 在既有签名握手中交换并验证每个来源的新挑战；应用回调仍须签名和验证收到的完整输入。此过程不增加公开 discovery 或握手配置。
verifyCredentials 可返回 { principalId: 非空字符串 }，把真实认证主体交给当前 Session；抛出或拒绝仍拒绝认证。void、字符串及其他原先被忽略的结果不会授予主体身份。

原六个 `/features/{auth,batch,chunk,idempotency,limits,schema}` 入口已删除，改从 `/plugins/*` 或 `/plugins` 导入。`rpcHostPipelines` 删除第三参数与 `pipelines` 输出，改为转交真实构造请求；管道由传输声明。以下无抛出点错误码已删除，不提供替代码：`HOST_ASSEMBLER_DUPLICATE`, `HOST_FEATURE_DUPLICATE`, `PROVIDER_GENERATION_RETIRED`, `MIDDLEWARE_DUPLICATED`, `MIDDLEWARE_MISSING`, `PROVIDER_NOT_SETTLED`, `TARGET_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE`。

被父端拉起的子节点优先使用真实父端指定的名字与 instanceId。父端未命名时，保留显式的子节点 `self.name`；子节点也未命名时，默认名随父端的 instanceId 更新。可按子节点握手报回的名字寻址。显式子节点名字或 instanceId 被父端覆盖时，只发出一次 `RpcWarningCode.selfIgnored`（`SELF_IGNORED`）警告。警告为 `{ code, message, data }`，`data` 只含实际被忽略的项：`parentName`/`ignoredName`、`parentInstanceId`/`ignoredInstanceId`。先交给 `onWarning` 选项，再交给宿主级 SDK 订阅插件；无人接收才用 `console.warn`。警告本身不进 report，接收者失败则报告原错并继续。冲突的父端启动事实仍为 `INVALID_CONFIG`。见警告订阅。

同时安装 `@migaia/rpc-host`、`@migaia/rpc-contract` 和所需传输插件，三者使用相同版本。contract 是精确 lockstep 的 peer 依赖，由应用提供同一份安装；开发者显式引入的重复副本不在支持范围内。

blocks.text: contract 只定义协议、接口、可移植值和错误契约。host 负责 RPC 的会话、握手、调用、provider、转发、取消与截止时间传递。传输 plugin 负责原生连接、代际和编解码；信息流 plugin 与依附于 plugin 的 feature 各自实现可选能力。
一个 host 支持多个传输命名空间，但通常选择一种传输，不建议混用。所有调用写成 `host.<ns>.*`；`provide` 与整个 host 的 `close` 留在根上。完整可运行的双向协程示例见 README。
`createRpcHost` 先在同一个原生宿主上提交信息流 plugin、链路策略 plugin 及其 feature，再安装传输 plugin 及其 feature。这样 auth 等 stage 在首次握手前已经可见。两次安装共用生命周期 owner；传输安装失败时，已提交的前缀也由该 owner 回滚和清理。

sections.heading: 注册普通方法与生成器

blocks.text: `provide` 接受嵌套函数对象。返回值成为业务结果，异常保留原错误链；重复方法名拒绝。运行中新增的方法通过原会话目录更新发布。
注册配置的反射或编译过程抛出异常时，公开入口以 `INVALID_CONFIG` 拒绝，并在 `cause` 上保留这个原异常。错误说明使用稳定文本，不调用异常的字符串转换，也不人为增加一项转换失败。
调用方通过 `options.signal` 取消，处理方读取自己的 `context.signal`。示例 `wait` 等待取消；实际任务应在自己的 finally 中释放资源。取消不回滚已执行副作用，也不自动终止进程。需要可取消、可知道何时完成的远程动作，请使用 `request`。
声明可描述一个能力，或按直连名称映射多个能力。命名空间决定使用哪个传输，名称和实例 id 决定该传输内的目标。
无目标 `request/notify/group` 在该命名空间内广播：零目标得到空 `fulfilled/rejected`，单目标返回标量，多目标各自保留成功或失败。多目标 `stream` 返回按实例身份索引的迭代器集合，每个迭代器独立背压和取消。
`streamTo(targetId, method, payload?, options?)` 定向选择一个直连目标，始终返回一个惰性迭代器；目标与 `send` 一样放在第一个参数。将原 `stream(method, payload, { targetId })` 改为此写法，options 只保留调用策略、signal、transfer 等原有选项。
stream 在第一次 `next()` 才启动。调用 `return()` 结束消费并等待对应清理；`throw(reason)` 保留调用方抛出的原因。连接失效后，已持有能力仍绑定原连接，不能转向同名新实例。
下例只创建冷定义；把 `policy` 与 `transport` 交给 `createRpcHost({ plugins: [...] })`，并在 worker 入口安装对应子端来源。
解析顺序唯一：单次调用完整实例或 `false`，然后传输 plugin 的 feature，最后链路策略 plugin。把 `callOptions` 传给 `host.thread.request(method, payload, callOptions)` 即可覆盖本次调用。不能写 `{ timeout: 100 }`、`timeoutMs` 或 `defaultTimeoutMs`。
`timeout: false` 不启用 feature 超时，持续等待响应；已经继承的上游剩余期限仍递减。`retry: false` 禁用重试。下游只得到剩余预算，转发不能延期。只有发起方的标量调用和 group 重试，stream 从不重放、只使用 timeout；超时或失联不证明业务未执行，非幂等操作须先对账。传输提供的握手准备期限是另一项配置，不是业务 timeout feature。
进入 provider 前剩余截止时间已经耗尽的调用，以 `DEADLINE_EXCEEDED` 拒绝，不执行 provider；`before-start` 的取消语义保持不变。
`createRpcHost({ plugins })` 构造时安装的整批定义一起成功或一起回滚。构造完成后，`host.use(...)` 每次开启一个独立的原生安装事务；失败只回滚本批新资源，已提交的命名空间继续工作。返回值还是同一个公开 host；用新变量接住它，才能在类型上取得新命名空间。

传输插件的名字就是命名空间；重复名字或保留名在安装前被拒绝。改变消息流的宿主级 Feature（如 auth、limits）只能放在构造时的 `createRpcHost({ plugins })` 中，只准备一次；后装会以 `INVALID_CONFIG` 拒绝。后装传输沿用同一份安装与共享额度，传输自己的 `features` 随传输一起安装，同种能力只覆盖本命名空间。只读观察插件，包括警告订阅，可以后装。`use` 返回的仍是同一个冻结的原生宿主；新增命名空间只体现在 `const extended = await host.use(...)` 的返回类型中。

`unUse(name)` 沿用原生卸载结果 `{ ok, affected, errors? }`。没有活动信息流约束时，卸载先按正常关闭流程关闭该传输的会话，再删除其管道组。会话仍在使用所选宿主级 Feature，或传输自己持有的局部 Feature 时，移除相应注册会以 `plugin.host / LIFECYCLE_MUTATION` 拒绝；共享 Feature 的卸载单位是原生共享封装，局部 Feature 的卸载单位是所属传输。先关闭受影响命名空间的会话，再冷删除；示例因此先调用 `thread.close()`。没有选中信息流 Feature 的传输、只读观察插件不受这项限制。宿主关闭或重新构造后也可去掉能力，框架不再保证原来的能力。
auth、chunk、batch 等通过握手协商并改变线上格式的能力，只有两端都装时才保证能建立通信。只装一端时不提供兼容，也不会主动禁止这种配置；应用需要自行提供匹配的 plugin 或 feature。

sections.heading: 在已有宿主中安装 RPC

blocks.text: 已有 `defineHost` 宿主使用 `rpcHostPipelines(getHost, pipeline)` 取得 `domainCore`。helper 构造时不调用回调、不创建宿主或资源；安装时才读取真实宿主，并把本次原生构造请求交还给这个宿主的 `pipeline(name, request)`。传输插件自己声明七条短名管道，安装时创建、卸载时删除，不需要预先列出命名空间，也不再有 `rpc.pipelines`。不要复制声明，或借用另一个宿主的执行权。
`rpcFlowPlugin(features)` 是普通原生宿主安装共享信息流 Feature 的封装，实际 setup 与清理由原生注册持有；不能把 `authFeature()` 等 Feature 直接当原生 plugin 交给 `host.use`。先提交这个封装和只读观察插件，再装传输，确保首次握手已经有完整策略。
class 宿主同样通过 helper 延迟读取 `this`。`createPluginDomainCore` 必须转交本次构造请求；无需公开原本受保护的 `pipeline`。构造完成后按上面的顺序安装 plugin。

`defineFlowFeature` 的每次 `setup` 返回本次安装的 `stages`，该 feature 放进宿主的 `plugins` 或某个传输的 `features`；setup 同时返回独立的 `observe` 与可选 `dispose`。stage 使用 SDK 的 `RpcFlowPoint` 和推导出的 payload 类型，转发时调用原生 `next(payload)`。握手、信封和 frame 的替换值分别放在 `handshake`、`prepared` 和 `frame`；dispatch 转发后从同一个 `payload.outcome.value` 读取结果，短路时也写入这个 cell。
frame 管道允许多次提交。每次 `await next(payload)` 的失败交给当前 stage：捕获并 report 后可以继续下一个成员；stage 不观察失败的 Promise 时，管道在所有已启动遍历结算后拒绝，多个未观察失败按提交顺序汇总。观察回调不负责执行或推进这些 stage。
`batchFeature` 中取消的成员不再向下游提交，原调用以 `CANCELLED` 结算，原 reason 保留在 `cause`；同批其他成员继续完成。入站某个成员失败只 report 该成员，不阻止后续成员。
内置位置固定：出站 plaintext → schema → idempotency → limits → errorMap → auth → chunk → batch → wire；入站反向。数组书写顺序不改变这些位置。第三方 stage 默认在 plaintext，高阶 SDK 作者可显式指定受支持的 `layer`。

`authFeature` 对完整消息执行保护，再由 `chunkFeature` 拆成物理帧；接收端先重组，再还原保护。probe 的 `protected` 事件对应整条消息，`frame` 事件保留实际 `chunkIndex`、`chunkCount` 和 `members`。物理 batch 的成员数在 batch frame 上观察；`envelope` 事件仍对每条逻辑消息观察一次。

`chunkFeature({ maxConcurrentMessagesPerSource, maxBufferedBytesPerSource })` 为每个物理来源设置子配额。默认分别为 64 条未完成消息和 16 MiB，低于默认全局 256 条和 64 MiB；默认来源并发取 `min(64, max(1, floor(maxConcurrentMessages / 4)))`，默认来源字节取 `max(maxMessageBytes, min(16777216, floor(maxBufferedBytes / 4)))`，保证一条允许的完整消息能获得预留。显式 `maxBufferedBytesPerSource` 小于 `maxMessageBytes` 时，构造会按既有配置错误拒绝。首片按完整声明长度预留来源字节额度，完成、过期或来源关闭时归还。超出来源配额只拒绝该来源的新分片消息，已接纳消息继续使用其预留额度；其他来源仍受各自子配额和原全局实际保留字节预算约束。字符串额度单位为 UTF-16 code unit，二进制为字节。

本地 codec capture 在原遍历中按节点累计常数时间 JSON 字节下界，不对字符串、键、二进制标签或元数据调用 `JSON.stringify`。下界超过当前 `maxFrameBytes` 时立即以 `FRAME_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` 拒绝，避免共享引用的指数展开；下界未超限时，唯一的实际编码出口仍按真实 UTF-8 长度检查同一上限。下界不会大于真实 JSON 字节数；正常共享引用仍按 JSON 逐次展开，线上表示保持不变。

载体可选实现 `reserveWrite(options)`，借用原有流控 owner，返回带 `release()` 的容量凭据。Session 在编码之后为一次逻辑写出预留一次，等这次 frame 管道实际结算后释放；chunk 的所有分片借用同一凭据，batch 各成员保留各自凭据，合并的物理写出借用仍存活成员的凭据。载体的 `write` 仍在实际物理接纳后完成，不应再把分片或 batch 重复计为新的逻辑调用。凭据不进入线上数据。

同一组 `authFeature`、`chunkFeature`、`batchFeature`、`idempotencyFeature`、`limitsFeature`、`errorMapFeature`、`schemaFeature` 工厂支持 host 的 `plugins` 与传输的 `features`；传输配置只覆盖本命名空间。host 级 `limitsFeature` 共用额度，传输级各自独立。`probe`、`typegen`、Devtools 只装在 host 级。删除原 `namespaces` 作用范围选项，改为把 feature 放在对应传输上。
默认 `encodedType: 'any'` 且未配置 `encrypt` 时，`sign` 收到带 nonce、counter 和对象 payload 的签名绑定对象，`verify` 收到对端还原出的同一结构。回调必须签名、验证完整输入；框架不先将它转换成文本。HMAC 等按字节处理的算法由应用决定规范化方式，两端必须一致。

显式选择 `'string'`、`'uint8array'`，或配置 `encrypt` 时，绑定改用带前缀的文本或相应 UTF-8 字节。整个绑定只编码一次，里面的 payload 仍是对象，入站只解析这层文本。加密仍先于签名，入站先验证再解密；支持的原生对象路径保持不变。原先假定默认输入总是文本的回调，应自行 `JSON.stringify` 或改用 `encodedType: 'string'`。nonce、签名计数器窗口及其重放检查没有改变。
auth 始终挡住还在执行的同一请求 ID，直到实际业务及 stream 清理完成。完成后如何释放由 `retain` 决定：

rows: 只保留在途身份，不按已完成请求数累积
原签名计数器被 64 位窗口越过时
必须配置签名，否则为 `INVALID_CONFIG`；窗口前进不释放仍在执行的请求
非法数字以 `INVALID_CONFIG` 拒绝；数值模式受容量限制

blocks.text: 可以在 `authFeature({ retain })` 设置默认值，也可以在传输连接选项 `connect: { retain }` 中覆盖；只有未指定连接值时才回退，所以连接级 `false` 也会覆盖宿主设置。需要旧的 310 秒行为时显式配置 `retain: 310_000`。

`maxReplayEntriesPerPeer` 默认 `1024`，只限制数字模式中的活动与保留身份，必须是正安全整数；满额以 `OVERLOADED` 拒绝。`false` 和 `'window'` 不受这个数值容量限制。`onRejected` 接收冻结的 `replayLedgerFull` 或 `groupReplayFull` 通知，回调失败仍按原错误及原因报告。重复请求静默丢弃，不再次执行，也不补发终态；需要把已完成结果回放给重发方时，安装 `idempotencyFeature()`。
verifier 或凭据解析器抛出、拒绝时，auth 在本地错误的 `cause` 上保留原始错误。用 `errorMapFeature(map)` 决定对端能看到哪些错误信息，例如把含凭据的细节换成公开提示。本地抛出的错误、`report`、警告和只读观察插件看到的仍是原始错误，与插件安装先后无关。它可放在宿主 `plugins` 或传输 `features`，传输级覆盖宿主级。

`map(error, context)` 必须同步返回 `Error`、可移植值或 `undefined`。返回值就是发给对端的错误内容，不自动附加原错的原因链。回调抛错或返回值无法序列化时，报告映射失败，并按未映射时的规则发送原错误。返回 Promise/thenable 时报告 `INVALID_CONFIG`，立即按原规则发送，不等待它，因此同一会话的后续消息不会被它卡住；迟到的 Promise 拒绝仍会单独报告。
没有 `errorMapFeature` 时，未认证对端收到的握手拒绝默认隐藏细节；其他错误保留完整的原因链。跨进程或线程会还原成新对象，不保证与发送方原错 `===`。需要隐藏对端可见信息时配置映射，本地日志和原因链仍可用于排查。
连接或 Auth 安装在验签中途关闭时，这次入站处理按取消结束，不再报告为认证失败；原始取消原因仍保留，真正的验签失败照常报告。直接执行 Auth SDK 阶段的调用者，在安装关闭后会得到现有的 `UtilsAbortError` 及原始 `cause`，而不是 `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED`。

载体支持原生二进制时，显式列在 `transfer` 中的 ArrayBuffer 始终原生转移，实际移交后原 buffer 被 detach；配置签名时也会计算并校验 SHA-256。没有显式转移的 buffer 在签名路径上才按大小处理：不超过 1125 字节时复制到签名内容中，原 buffer 保留可用，也不计算摘要；较大的 buffer 用原生二进制传送并校验摘要。未配置签名时不计算二进制摘要。1125 字节是 SDK 内部阈值，不是公开配置项。
大小和摘要针对整个 ArrayBuffer，Uint8Array 的可见切片再小，也不会缩小其底层 buffer。共享同一 buffer 的视图在接收端仍共享同一 buffer，并保留各自的偏移和长度。
`transfer` 表示移交所有权，只能使用调用方显式授权的 buffer，并且载体必须支持这种移交；不支持时仍按原能力规则拒绝。普通调用者不必处理二进制清单，载体作者所需的线上格式见 contract 协议说明。

`notify` 的 Promise 只表示物理发送，不表示业务确认。普通 `notify`（没有 `cancel: 'before-start'`、没有 `orderKey`，且非转发）发送完成后解除调用方 signal 监听；之后 abort 不再发送远端取消。`dispatch(target, method, payload, options)` 同步返回 `void`，失败交给原 reporter。每个目标按顺序执行自己的 group，没有跨目标事务。
安装 `idempotencyFeature()` 信息流 Feature 后，才有 `host.<ns>.outcome(key)` 查询保留的结果。省略时不启用按幂等键保存和查询结果的存储。auth 的请求 ID 去重与它独立，三种保留方式见认证说明。推荐安装 `limitsFeature()`；不安装就不启用相应并发、速率或 payload 配额。
`host.process.send('b', 'c.render', value)` 先到 b；b 查询当前目录，再通过自己持有的 c 会话转发，可跨载体。也可显式发布已持有能力：
持有的函数不自动跟随替换。目标断开时拒绝；未知方法、环路与超出跳数在原准入边界拒绝。转发不创建第二个调用端点或 per-session Peer 外观。
在每个转发 host 上设置 `createRpcHost({ forward: { maxHops: 3 }, plugins: [...] })`。省略时为 3，只接受 1–16 的整数。各 host 将当前转发跳序与自身上限比较；环路拒绝先于 `FORWARD_HOP_LIMIT`。

probe 的 `forward` 阶段发出 `received`、实际交给载体时的 `sent`，或带 `loop`、`hop-limit`、`target-unknown`、`method-unavailable` 原因的 `rejected`。首个转发 host 的 `hop` 为 1，`maxHops` 为自身上限。`route` 仅借用到回调返回，保留事件前须复制；最终目标的 message 入站事件带经过的 `hop` 与 `route`。不装 probe 或 Devtools 时，Forwarder 跳过事件构造。
观察通过同一 host 的 `probe` 信息流 plugin 安装；类型生成消费已接受目录。事件视图只在 `emit` 期间有效，延后读取前须复制需要的字段。
把这两个定义与传输一起放入 `plugins`。`typegen.out.write` 是应用拥有的输出能力，文件 I/O 由应用决定；失败通过 reporter 传播。关闭 host 或卸载相应 plugin 后释放订阅。

警告是冻结的 `{ code, message, data }` 记录，不是错误，不会进 `report`，也不阻止构造或调用。每条记录先交给 `createRpcHost({ onWarning })`，再按注册顺序交给宿主级 SDK 插件 setup 返回的 `onWarning`；所有接收者拿到同一个记录。没有接收者时只调用一次 `console.warn`。接收者抛错或异步拒绝时，报告原错误，其他接收者继续收到警告。
只读警告订阅可后装，卸载或安装回滚时由原生注册移除。订阅只能由宿主级 `defineFlowPlugin` 提供；放进传输 `features`，或让 `defineFlowFeature` 返回 `onWarning`，均以 `INVALID_CONFIG` 拒绝。

被父端拉起并收到真实原生启动事实的子节点（process、thread、coroutine、dedicated worker 或 pool 成员）优先使用父端指定名，`instanceId` 也以父端事实为准。父端未命名时，保留子节点显式的 `self.name`；子节点也未命名时，默认名随父端的 instanceId 更新。用子节点握手报回的名字寻址。显式子节点名字或 instanceId 被父端覆盖时，构造成功，只发出一次 `RpcWarningCode.selfIgnored`（`SELF_IGNORED`）警告。`warning.data` 只含实际被忽略的项：名字冲突带 `parentName`/`ignoredName`，身份冲突带 `parentInstanceId`/`ignoredInstanceId`；只有 instanceId 不同也会警告。两份冲突的父端启动事实仍以 `INVALID_CONFIG` 拒绝。

单一 Host 调用 owner 与新协议，无兼容入口

blocks.text: `remote.host.use`、`remote.host.unUse` 和 `remote.host.inspect` 已移除，不再提供通过 RPC 管理远端宿主插件的协议；本地原生宿主的安装与释放 API 保持各自契约。

汇总入口和各单项默认子路径均可 tree-shake。错误码从 `@migaia/rpc-contract/error-code` 引入；应用使用的错误类、错误判断和类型改从 `@migaia/rpc-host/contract` 引入，根入口不再提供这些转出。`RpcConstructionError` 与 `RpcAbortError` 在此为运行时类，可以用于 `instanceof`；它们与直接 contract 导入保持同一对象。该入口同时提供 `normalizeRpcPortable` 与类型 `IRpcPortableValue`，可用于已协商 native 值的严格 own-data 域规范化；不为调用者复制或安装另一份 contract。SDK 和 limits 面向插件作者的原有类型转出保持不变。传输作者只提交原生载体与编解码能力，host 负责握手、Session、待决表与 provider 执行。
`host.close()` 与 `host[Symbol.asyncDispose]()` 共享原关闭 Promise；`host.<ns>.close()` 只关闭对应命名空间。拥有的原生资源由其原 owner 释放，借用资源仍按原生所有权处理。
公开关闭会以 `ENDPOINT_DISPOSED` 结算待决调用，并关闭真实载体。载体的 `close` 要结算自己拥有的排队写入，因此被挂住的原生写入也会拒绝；它不等于强行完成任意业务 Promise。已有 `defineHost` 或 class 宿主的 `dispose()` 仍返回其原生 cleanup summary 与共享 Promise，不套另一层 RPC 清理外壳。
按 `source/code` 识别错误，保留原生类型、stack、cause 与 errors。不要把超时、取消或未知结果当成业务未执行证明。原生成员控制位于传输贡献的 `host.<ns>.members`，池控制位于其 feature 贡献的 `host.<ns>.pool`；这些控制不替代调用入口。

`send`、`request` 等返回 Promise 的调用通过拒绝传播非法 `idempotencyKey`、transfer 准入被拒绝或命名空间已关闭的错误，保留各入口原有的 `source/code` 和 `cause`；非法 key 仍为 `CONTRACT_INVALID`。使用 `await` 或 `Promise.catch` 处理失败。`dispatch` 仍同步返回 `void` 并向 reporter 交付失败，`stream` 与 `streamTo` 仍返回延迟启动的异步迭代器。

未分类的 provider 异常使用 `INTERNAL`，原生异常保留在错误图中。标量调用直接以还原的远端 Error 拒绝；不再增加 `RpcRemoteError` 外壳，调用方须改用真实错误的 `source/code`。协程远端 `context.signal.reason` 接收原 abort reason，不合成取消码；`stream.return(value)` 返回 runtime 的真实结束结果，不回传调用者传入的 `value`。
无目标调用按调用时已接受的会话选择；从 `peers` 保存的函数绑定原代次，退场后拒绝且不转向替代连接。即时 process 启动失败只保留一层 `PROCESS_CHANNEL_CLOSED`，原生 EPIPE 在 cause 图中；没有真实原生错误的 thread 关闭诊断不合成 message-port cause。
自行构造的原生宿主保留 `dispose()` 的原生 cleanup summary 与共享 Promise，不再附加 RPC 清理外壳。原失败叶对象、errors 顺序、cause 可达性和 disposer 一次执行保持；`createRpcHost` 返回的 `host.close()` 则保持自己的公开关闭语义。
幂等指纹使用对象自身的键序；同一 body 改变键序后是不同请求，同键冲突以 `CONTRACT_INVALID` 拒绝，原 store 的字符串指纹 ABI 保持不变。
原生 Feature 的 descriptors 每次冷编译只捕获一次，首次 selector 的校验及错误顺序保持；后续 selector 不再重复触发 Proxy reflection。
auth 默认以对象交给 sign/verify；依赖旧文本输入时自行规范化或选择 `encodedType: 'string'`。完成的请求 ID 默认立即释放，需要旧保留时长时设置 `retain: 310_000`。本地 verifier/凭据解析错误保留原 cause，对端脱敏改用同步 `errorMapFeature`。

blocks.text: `@migaia/rpc-contract` is an exact lockstep peer dependency. Install the same version alongside the host and transport plugins. They share the application's single contract installation; explicitly installed duplicate copies are unsupported.

Import error classes, error predicates, and portable values from `@migaia/rpc-host/contract`. It forwards the named values `RpcLifecycleError`, `RpcConstructionError`, `RpcAbortError`, `isRpcError`, `isRpcErrorInstance`, `isRpcRemoteError`, `isRpcTimeoutError`, `RPC_CORE_ERROR_SOURCE`, and `normalizeRpcPortable`, plus error types such as `RpcError` and the portable-value type `IRpcPortableValue`. All contract values and types formerly exported at the root have moved here without compatibility exports; import `createRpcHost` from the root as before.

This creates two real hosts in one event loop. The parent installs its timeout feature on the coroutine plugin. The child receives the generation-local connect handle. It prints `42` and releases native resources in finally.
Coroutines do not provide Worker isolation. Choose the process, thread, or browser transport for those native environments.

`createRpcHost` first commits flow plugins, link-policy plugins and their features, then installs transport plugins and their features on the same native plugin-host. Stages such as auth are available before transport handshake begins. The same lifecycle owner rolls back and releases acquired resources if a later installation fails.

After construction, `const extended = await host.use(transport)` installs another transport and returns the same frozen native host with an added namespace in the return type. Each `use` commits or rolls back independently; the construction batch succeeds or fails together. Host Features that change message flow must be configured in the construction `plugins`; adding them later rejects with `INVALID_CONFIG`. Later transports borrow them, and their own `features` install with the transport and override only its namespace. Readonly observer plugins, including warning subscriptions, may be installed later.

An existing `defineHost` or class owner obtains `domainCore` from SDK `rpcHostPipelines(getHost, pipeline)` and forwards the native construction request to `pipeline(name, request)`. Each transport declares its own pipelines, without an advance namespace list. Ordinary native hosts install shared flow Features through `rpcFlowPlugin([...features])` before transports. blocks.text: Untargeted calls select only within their namespace: zero targets return empty `fulfilled/rejected` maps, one returns a scalar, and multiple return maps indexed by instance identity. Stream iterators cancel independently. Root call methods such as `host.request` are removed.

Use `streamTo` for a directed stream, with the target as its first argument. `stream` options no longer accept `targetId`. Both methods share the same backpressure, cancellation, and generation isolation.

`remote.host.use`, `remote.host.unUse` and `remote.host.inspect` are removed. RPC no longer provides a protocol for managing a remote host's plugins; local native host installation and disposal keep their own contracts.

`host.<ns>.send('b', 'c.render', value)` first reaches direct peer b, which reads its current directory and forwards to c. A held `host.<ns>.peers.c.render` does not retarget a later generation. Forwarding can cross namespaces and cannot extend an upstream deadline.

Configure each forwarding host with `forward: { maxHops: 3 }` in `createRpcHost`. The default is 3; integers 1–16 are supported and other values reject with `INVALID_CONFIG`. Each host checks its own forwarding ordinal; loops reject before the hop limit.

The same `authFeature`, `chunkFeature`, `batchFeature`, `idempotencyFeature`, `limitsFeature`, `errorMapFeature`, and `schemaFeature` factories work in host `plugins` and transport `features`. Host placement supplies every namespace; transport placement overrides that capability only in its namespace. Each namespace has one implementation of each capability. Host `limitsFeature` shares quotas across namespaces; transport `limitsFeature` owns separate quotas. `probe`, `typegen`, and Devtools are host-only plugins. The former `namespaces` scope option is removed; select a transport with `features`.

Aggregate and default subpath imports support tree-shaking. Installing `limitsFeature` is recommended; omitting it enables no such quotas. `host.<ns>.outcome(key)` exists only with `idempotencyFeature` installed. Auth passes the signing binding object to `sign/verify` by default; text and byte modes encode one binding layer. Its request-ID deduplication releases completed IDs immediately by default, with signed-window or millisecond `retain` alternatives. `maxReplayEntriesPerPeer` bounds only numeric retention mode, and `onRejected` receives capacity refusal reasons. See authentication for configuration and HMAC examples.

`errorMapFeature` synchronously controls the error information a peer receives without changing local originals, reports, warnings, or log observation. A throw, returned Promise, or unserializable result reports the mapping failure and sends the original error under the rules used without a mapper. Without a mapper, handshake refusals still hide details from unauthenticated peers. See error mapping.

A custom flow returns `stages` from `defineFlowFeature` setup; place the feature in host `plugins` or in one transport's `features`. Each stage receives its pipeline payload and native `next(payload)`; readonly events belong in the separate `observe` field. Frame pipelines allow independent submissions: after catching and reporting one member's failure, a stage can submit another. Ignoring a failed `next()` Promise rejects the pipeline. The original call settles a cancelled batch member with `CANCELLED` and its original reason on `cause`; other members complete normally.

Builtin positions are fixed: outbound plaintext → schema → idempotency → limits → errorMap → auth → chunk → batch → wire; inbound reverses the direction. Array order does not change these positions. Third-party stages default to plaintext; SDK authors may select the supported `layer` explicitly.

`authFeature` protects each complete message before `chunkFeature` splits it into physical frames. The receiver reassembles the message before restoring protection. Probe `protected` events describe the complete message; `frame` events retain actual `chunkIndex`, `chunkCount` and `members`. Physical batch membership is observed on its batch frame, while each logical message has one `envelope` observation.

A custom carrier may implement optional `reserveWrite` by borrowing its existing flow-control capacity. Reserve once per logical write: chunk fragments share its receipt, while a batch retains each member's receipt until completion. `write` still completes at actual physical acceptance, and `close` must settle carrier-owned queued writes.

When the carrier supports native binary, an ArrayBuffer explicitly listed in `transfer` always transfers natively and the original buffer detaches on handoff; signing also calculates and verifies its digest. Small buffers without an explicit transfer may be inline when signed, leaving the original usable. Without signing, binary digests are not calculated. Views sharing a buffer retain their aliases and offsets. See binary integrity.

Shared or local flow Features used by open Sessions cannot be hot-unloaded: removal of their native registration rejects with `LIFECYCLE_MUTATION`. Close affected namespace Sessions before cold removal. Capabilities such as auth, chunk, and batch change the wire format; only two-sided installation guarantees establishment. One-sided configuration has no compatibility guarantee and is not proactively prohibited. See later installation and removal.

Pool is the transport's `pool({ size })` feature. Members use one carrier kind and expose one logical peer. Pool owns member acquisition, scheduling, and closure; the transport contributes native `host.<ns>.members` controls.

`FeatureScope` alone selects call `options.timeout/retry`, then the transport's installed feature, then the link-policy default. Call values accept only complete feature instances or `false`, never numbers or configuration objects. `timeout: false` waits for the response without a feature timeout; an upstream remaining deadline still decreases. `retry: false` disables retry. Only the origin retries scalar calls and groups; streams never replay and use timeout only; forwarding does not restart the budget.
A call whose remaining deadline has expired before provider entry rejects with `DEADLINE_EXCEEDED` without executing the provider. `before-start` cancellation keeps its existing semantics.

Every call kind supports `signal`, including cancellation propagated after a one-way physical send. Providers receive their own `context.signal`. Cancellation neither kills a process nor rolls back side effects.

Branch on `source/code`; preserve native classes, `stack`, `cause`, and `AggregateError.errors`. Timeout or disconnection does not prove that business work never executed. Reconcile uncertain non-idempotent work before retrying.

Promise-returning calls such as `send` and `request` reject invalid `idempotencyKey` values, rejected transfer admission, or a closed namespace, preserving each entry's existing `source/code` and `cause`; invalid keys still use `CONTRACT_INVALID`. Handle failures with `await` or `Promise.catch`. `dispatch` still returns `void` and reports failures, while `stream` and `streamTo` still return lazy async iterators.

Public provider registration rejects with `INVALID_CONFIG` and retains the exact registration failure directly on `cause`; diagnostic text does not invoke the thrown value's string conversion. Closing settles pending calls with `ENDPOINT_DISPOSED`, and actual carrier closure rejects held writes. Closing does not force an arbitrary business Promise to finish.

Plugin authors start at `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk`; observation lives under `/plugins/probe`. Old `/plugin`, `/probe`, endpoint, per-session Peer, and v1/JSON-RPC profile entries are removed. RPC module can depend directly on `@migaia/rpc-contract`. Import only `/error-code` when only codes are needed, without retaining protocol or codec execution code.

Unhandled provider exceptions use `INTERNAL` and retain the native exception in the error graph. Scalar calls reject with the restored remote Error directly, without an extra `RpcRemoteError`; callers must inspect the actual error's `source/code`. A coroutine provider receives the original abort reason through `context.signal.reason`, without an invented cancellation code. `stream.return(value)` returns the runtime's actual terminal result rather than echoing the caller's `value`.

Untargeted calls select the sessions accepted at call time. Functions saved from `peers` remain bound to their original generation and reject after departure rather than switching to a replacement. Immediate process startup failure has one `PROCESS_CHANNEL_CLOSED` boundary with native EPIPE reachable through its cause graph. A thread closure with no native error does not invent a message-port cause.

An independently constructed native host retains its native `dispose()` cleanup summary and shared Promise without an additional RPC cleanup shell. Original failure leaves, errors order, cause reachability and once-only disposal remain intact. The `host.close()` returned by `createRpcHost` retains its own public close semantics.

Idempotency fingerprints follow the object's own key order. Changing key order creates a different request; reuse of the same key conflicts with `CONTRACT_INVALID`. The store's string fingerprint ABI is unchanged.
Native Feature descriptors are captured once per cold compilation while preserving the first selector validation and error order; later selectors do not repeat Proxy reflection.

Auth changes its default signing input from text to an object. Normalize it in callbacks or set `encodedType: 'string'` when text is required. Completed request IDs release immediately by default; set `retain: 310_000` for the former behavior. Local verifier and credential resolver errors retain their original causes; synchronous `errorMapFeature` controls remote redaction.

With sign/verify configured, auth exchanges and validates a fresh source challenge inside the existing signed handshake. Application callbacks must still sign and verify the complete input they receive. No public discovery or handshake option is added.

verifyCredentials may return { principalId: nonemptyString } to lend the authenticated principal to the current Session. Throwing or rejection still refuses authentication. Void, string, and other formerly ignored results do not grant a principal.

The six former `/features/{auth,batch,chunk,idempotency,limits,schema}` entries are removed; import their factories from `/plugins/*` or `/plugins`. `rpcHostPipelines` removes its third argument and `pipelines` output: forward the actual construction request instead, and let transports declare pipelines. The following unused error codes are removed without replacement: `HOST_ASSEMBLER_DUPLICATE`, `HOST_FEATURE_DUPLICATE`, `PROVIDER_GENERATION_RETIRED`, `MIDDLEWARE_DUPLICATED`, `MIDDLEWARE_MISSING`, `PROVIDER_NOT_SETTLED`, `TARGET_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE`.

Launched children prefer the actual parent-supplied name and instanceId. Without a parent name, an explicit child `self.name` remains; without either name, the default follows the parent's instanceId. Address the name reported in the child's handshake. Overriding an explicit child name or instanceId emits one `RpcWarningCode.selfIgnored` (`SELF_IGNORED`) warning. Warnings have `{ code, message, data }`; `data` includes only the overridden pairs: `parentName`/`ignoredName` and `parentInstanceId`/`ignoredInstanceId`. Delivery goes first to the `onWarning` option, then host-level SDK subscribers, with `console.warn` only when no recipient exists. The warning itself is not reported; recipient failures report their originals and delivery continues. Conflicting parent startup facts still reject with `INVALID_CONFIG`. See warning subscriptions.

sections.heading: Install and remove transports after construction

blocks.text: The complete definition batch passed to `createRpcHost({ plugins })` either succeeds or rolls back together. After construction, each `host.use(...)` starts a separate native installation transaction. Failure rolls back only that batch's new resources; committed namespaces keep working. The returned value is the same public host. Assign it to a new variable to obtain the added namespaces in its static type.

A transport plugin's name is its namespace. Duplicate and reserved names reject before installation. Host Features that change message flow, such as auth and limits, must be configured in the construction `createRpcHost({ plugins })`; they are prepared once, and adding them later rejects with `INVALID_CONFIG`. Later transports borrow the same installations and shared quotas. Their own `features` install with the transport and override that capability only in its namespace. Readonly observer plugins, including warning subscriptions, may be installed later. `use` returns the same frozen native host; the added namespace appears only in the return type captured by `const extended = await host.use(...)`.

`unUse(name)` retains the native removal result `{ ok, affected, errors? }`. Without an active flow restriction, removal closes the transport's Sessions through the normal close path before deleting its pipeline group. Removing a selected host Feature or a transport that owns a local Feature while affected Sessions remain open rejects with `plugin.host / LIFECYCLE_MUTATION`. Shared Features are removed with their native wrapper registration; local Features are removed with their transport. Close affected namespace Sessions before cold removal, as the example does with `thread.close()`. Transports with no selected flow Feature and readonly observer plugins are exempt from this restriction. Capabilities can also be omitted after Host closure or reconstruction, without preserving their former guarantees.

Capabilities such as auth, chunk, and batch negotiate through the handshake and change the wire representation. Establishment is guaranteed only when both peers install them. One-sided installation provides no compatibility guarantee and is not proactively prohibited; applications must supply matching plugins or features when needed.

sections.heading: Install RPC in an existing host

blocks.text: An existing `defineHost` owner obtains `domainCore` from `rpcHostPipelines(getHost, pipeline)`. Creating the helper calls neither callback and creates no host or resource. Installation reads the real owner and passes the current native construction request back to that owner's `pipeline(name, request)`. Each transport declares its own seven short pipeline names, created on installation and deleted on removal. There is no advance namespace list or `rpc.pipelines` output. Do not copy declarations or borrow another host's execution authority.

`rpcFlowPlugin(features)` wraps shared flow Features for an ordinary native host. The native registration owns their actual setup and cleanup; Features such as `authFeature()` cannot be passed directly to native `host.use` as plugins. Commit this wrapper and readonly observers before transports so the first handshake already has its complete policy.

A class owner also reads `this` lazily through the helper. `createPluginDomainCore` must forward the current construction request without exposing protected `pipeline`. Install plugins in the same order after construction finishes.

Each `defineFlowFeature` setup returns installation-local `stages`; install the feature through host `plugins` or one transport's `features`. The setup also returns a separate `observe` callback and optional `dispose`. Stages use SDK `RpcFlowPoint` keys with inferred payload types and forward through native `next(payload)`. Handshake, envelope and frame replacements belong in `handshake`, `prepared` and `frame`. Dispatch reads the same `payload.outcome.value` after forwarding, and writes that cell when short-circuiting.

Frame pipelines accept multiple submissions. The stage receives each `await next(payload)` failure and may catch, report and continue with another member. If it does not observe a failed Promise, the pipeline rejects after all started traversals settle; multiple unobserved failures are collected in submission order. Observation callbacks do not execute or advance stages.

A cancelled `batchFeature` member submits no further downstream work. Its call settles with `CANCELLED` and the original reason on `cause`; other members complete normally. An inbound member failure reports only that member and does not prevent later members from being processed.

Builtin positions are fixed: outbound plaintext → schema → idempotency → limits → errorMap → auth → chunk → batch → wire; inbound reverses the direction. Array order does not change these positions. Third-party stages default to plaintext; SDK authors may select the supported `layer` explicitly.

`authFeature` protects each complete message before `chunkFeature` splits it into physical frames. The receiver reassembles the message before restoring protection. Probe `protected` events describe the complete message; `frame` events retain actual `chunkIndex`, `chunkCount` and `members`. Physical batch membership is observed on its batch frame, while each logical message has one `envelope` observation.

`chunkFeature({ maxConcurrentMessagesPerSource, maxBufferedBytesPerSource })` sets quotas per physical source. Defaults are 64 incomplete messages and 16 MiB, below the global defaults of 256 messages and 64 MiB. The default source concurrency is `min(64, max(1, floor(maxConcurrentMessages / 4)))`; default source bytes are `max(maxMessageBytes, min(16777216, floor(maxBufferedBytes / 4)))`, so one admitted complete message can reserve capacity. An explicit `maxBufferedBytesPerSource` below `maxMessageBytes` rejects at construction through the existing configuration error. The first fragment reserves its complete declared length until completion, expiry, or source closure. Exceeding a source quota rejects only that source's new fragmented message; admitted messages keep their reservations. Other sources remain subject to their own quotas and the original global retained-byte budget. String quotas use UTF-16 code units; binary quotas use bytes.

Local codec capture accumulates a constant-time JSON byte lower bound per node during its original traversal. It never calls `JSON.stringify` on strings, keys, binary tags, or metadata. A lower bound above the current `maxFrameBytes` rejects immediately with `FRAME_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`, preventing exponential alias expansion. Otherwise, the sole actual encoding exit still checks real UTF-8 length against the same limit. The lower bound never exceeds actual JSON bytes; admitted aliases retain their ordinary independent expansion and unchanged wire representation.

A carrier may implement `reserveWrite(options)` by borrowing its existing flow-control owner and returning a receipt with `release()`. Session reserves once per logical write after encoding and releases when that frame pipeline actually settles. Chunk fragments share the same receipt; a batch retains each member's receipt and borrows a surviving member's receipt for its coalesced physical write. `write` still completes at actual physical acceptance, without counting fragments or batches as new logical calls. Receipts never enter wire data.

The same `authFeature`, `chunkFeature`, `batchFeature`, `idempotencyFeature`, `limitsFeature`, `errorMapFeature`, and `schemaFeature` factories support host `plugins` and transport `features`; transport placement overrides only its namespace. Host `limitsFeature` shares quotas; transport `limitsFeature` owns separate quotas. `probe`, `typegen`, and Devtools are host-only. Remove the former `namespaces` scope option and place the feature on its transport.

With the default `encodedType: 'any'` and no `encrypt`, `sign` receives the signing binding object, including nonce, counter, and an object payload. `verify` receives the same restored structure from its peer. Callbacks must sign and verify their complete input; the framework does not first convert it to text. Applications choose the representation for byte-oriented algorithms such as HMAC, and both peers must use the same choice.

Explicit `'string'`, `'uint8array'`, or `encrypt` uses prefixed text or its UTF-8 bytes instead. The entire binding is encoded once, with its payload still an object; inbound processing parses that text layer once. Encryption still precedes signing, and inbound verification precedes decryption. The supported native object path is unchanged. Callbacks that assumed text by default must normalize it themselves with `JSON.stringify` or select `encodedType: 'string'`. Nonces, the signed counter window, and their replay checks are unchanged.
Auth always deduplicates an in-flight request ID until actual business and stream cleanup completes. `retain` controls release after completion:

rows: Holds only in-flight identities, without accumulating completed requests
When the original signed counter falls outside the 64-bit window
Requires signing or rejects with `INVALID_CONFIG`; window advancement does not release active requests
Invalid numbers reject with `INVALID_CONFIG`; numeric mode has capacity limits

blocks.text: Set a default with `authFeature({ retain })` or override it in a transport connection's `connect: { retain }`. Only an omitted connection value falls back, so connection-level `false` also overrides the host setting. Set `retain: 310_000` explicitly for the former 310-second behavior.

`maxReplayEntriesPerPeer` defaults to `1024`, must be a positive safe integer, and bounds active and retained identities only in numeric mode. Full capacity rejects with `OVERLOADED`; `false` and `'window'` are not subject to that numeric capacity limit. `onRejected` receives frozen `replayLedgerFull` or `groupReplayFull` notices, and callback failures still report their original errors and causes. Duplicates are silently dropped without another execution or terminal response. Install `idempotencyFeature()` to replay a completed result to a retrying caller.

sections.heading: Map errors sent to the peer

blocks.text: When a verifier or credential resolver throws or rejects, auth retains the original error on the local error's `cause`. Use `errorMapFeature(map)` to control what a peer learns, such as replacing credential details with a public message. Local thrown errors, `report`, warnings, and readonly observation plugins still receive the original errors, regardless of installation order. Install it in host `plugins` or transport `features`; transport placement overrides host placement.

`map(error, context)` must synchronously return an `Error`, portable value, or `undefined`. That result becomes the error sent to the peer; the original cause chain is not appended automatically. If the callback throws or its result cannot be serialized, the mapping failure is reported and the original error is sent under the rules used without a mapper. Returning a Promise/thenable reports `INVALID_CONFIG` and immediately uses those original rules without waiting, so it cannot block later messages in the same Session. A late Promise rejection is still reported separately.

Without `errorMapFeature`, handshake refusals hide details from unauthenticated peers by default; other errors preserve the complete cause chain. Crossing a process or thread reconstructs objects and does not preserve `===` with the sender's original error. Configure mapping to hide information from peers while keeping local logs and causes available for diagnosis.

When a connection or Auth installation closes during verification, inbound processing ends as cancellation instead of reporting an authentication failure. The original cancellation reason is retained, and genuine verification failures are still reported. Callers executing Auth SDK stages directly receive the existing `UtilsAbortError` with its original `cause` after installation closure, rather than `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED`.

When the carrier supports native binary, an ArrayBuffer explicitly listed in `transfer` always transfers natively and the original buffer detaches on actual handoff; signing also calculates and verifies SHA-256. Only buffers without an explicit transfer follow the size rule when signed: at most 1125 bytes are copied into signed content, leaving the original usable and requiring no digest; larger buffers travel as native binary with digest verification. Without signing, binary digests are not calculated. The 1125-byte threshold is an internal SDK choice, not a public option.

Size and digest apply to the entire ArrayBuffer. A small visible Uint8Array slice does not shrink its underlying buffer. Views sharing a buffer still share one buffer at the receiver and retain their offsets and lengths.

`transfer` hands over ownership, uses only buffers explicitly authorized by the caller, and requires a carrier that supports that handoff; unsupported transfers still reject under the existing capability rules. Ordinary callers need not handle a binary manifest. Carrier authors can find the wire format in the contract guide.

A `notify` Promise means physical sending completed, without business acknowledgement. An ordinary `notify` with no `cancel: 'before-start'`, no `orderKey`, and no forwarding removes its caller-signal listener after sending; later aborts send no remote cancellation. `dispatch(target, method, payload, options)` returns `void` synchronously and reports failures. Each target executes its own ordered group; there is no cross-target transaction.

blocks.text: verifier 或凭据解析器抛出、拒绝时，auth 在本地错误的 `cause` 上保留原始错误。用 `errorMapFeature(map)` 决定对端能看到哪些错误信息，例如把含凭据的细节换成公开提示。本地抛出的错误、`report`、警告和只读观察插件看到的仍是原始错误，与插件安装先后无关。它可放在宿主 `plugins` 或传输 `features`，传输级覆盖宿主级。

`map(error, context)` 必须同步返回 `Error`、可移植值或 `undefined`。返回值就是发给对端的错误内容，不自动附加原错的原因链。回调抛错或返回值无法序列化时，报告映射失败，并按未映射时的规则发送原错误。返回 Promise/thenable 时报告 `INVALID_CONFIG`，立即按原规则发送，不等待它，因此同一会话的后续消息不会被它卡住；迟到的 Promise 拒绝仍会单独报告。
没有 `errorMapFeature` 时，未认证对端收到的握手拒绝默认隐藏细节；其他错误保留完整的原因链。跨进程或线程会还原成新对象，不保证与发送方原错 `===`。需要隐藏对端可见信息时配置映射，本地日志和原因链仍可用于排查。
连接或 Auth 安装在验签中途关闭时，这次入站处理按取消结束，不再报告为认证失败；原始取消原因仍保留，真正的验签失败照常报告。直接执行 Auth SDK 阶段的调用者，在安装关闭后会得到现有的 `UtilsAbortError` 及原始 `cause`，而不是 `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED`。

blocks.text: `FeatureScope` 唯一解析覆盖顺序：单次调用 `options.timeout/retry`、所在传输 plugin 的 feature、链路策略 plugin。单次值只接受完整 feature 实例或 `false`，不接受数字或配置对象。`timeout: false` 不启用 feature 超时，持续等待响应；已经继承的上游剩余期限仍递减。`retry: false` 禁用重试。只有发起方的标量调用和 group 重试，stream 从不重放、只使用 timeout；转发跳不重新开始预算。
进入 provider 前剩余截止时间已经耗尽的调用，以 `DEADLINE_EXCEEDED` 拒绝，不执行 provider；`before-start` 的取消语义保持不变。
所有调用种类支持 `signal`，单向调用物理发送之后也能向下游传播取消。provider 读取自己的 `context.signal`。取消不等于杀进程，也不回滚业务副作用。
按 `source/code` 识别错误，保留原生类型、`stack`、`cause` 和 `AggregateError.errors`。超时或断开不证明业务未执行；非幂等操作须先对账再考虑重试。

`send`、`request` 等返回 Promise 的调用通过拒绝传播非法 `idempotencyKey`、transfer 准入被拒绝或命名空间已关闭的错误，保留各入口原有的 `source/code` 和 `cause`；非法 key 仍为 `CONTRACT_INVALID`。使用 `await` 或 `Promise.catch` 处理失败。`dispatch` 仍同步返回 `void` 并向 reporter 交付失败，`stream` 与 `streamTo` 仍返回延迟启动的异步迭代器。
公开 provider 注册失败以 `INVALID_CONFIG` 拒绝，原注册错误直接保留在 `cause`；错误说明不通过调用异常的字符串转换来生成。关闭后，待决调用以 `ENDPOINT_DISPOSED` 结算，实际载体关闭会拒绝仍被挂住的写入；不要求任意业务 Promise 因关闭而强行完成。

自定义 plugin 作者从 `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk` 开始。观察入口是 `/plugins/probe`；旧 `/plugin`、`/probe`、endpoint、per-session Peer 和 v1/JSON-RPC profile 已删除。rpc 家族可以直接依赖 `@migaia/rpc-contract`；只需错误码时导入 `/error-code`，不会带入协议与编解码执行代码。
